# Crewservices

> > Maritime crew recruitment platform connecting seafarers with vessel positions across Russia, Lithuania, Estonia, and Ukraine.

Crewservices.ru is a specialized job board for maritime professionals, featuring vacancies for ship officers, engineers, and crew members on various vessel types including container ships, bulk carriers, tankers, and offshore vessels. The platform serves crewing agencies and seafarers primarily in the Black Sea, Baltic, and Caspian regions.

## Key Topics

- Maritime crew recruitment
- Ship engineer positions
- Chief Engineer vacancies
- Second Engineer jobs
- Maritime employment
- Crewing agencies (Russia, Lithuania, Ukraine)
- Container ship crew
- Bulk carrier positions
- Tanker crew jobs
- Offshore vessel employment
- 6-month contracts
- Astrakhan maritime jobs
- Klaipeda crew services
- Boatswain/Bosun positions
- Marine officer recruitment
